desc: Establish the cut-based characterization: every proper cut must have an added white-to-black edge from suffix to prefix.
Derive the bad-barrier inclusion-exclusion recurrence and endpoint zero conditions.
Implement the CDQ plus convolution evaluation of the recurrence.
Pass all three public sample tests.
Exhaustively validate recurrence and implementation against brute-force pairings on small instances.
Confirm worst-case Python runtime and memory are suitable for N = 2e5.
